title: 海边的风 Hǎibiān de fēng — The wind from the sea
summary: A rented bike, a torn tyre, and a roadside repair stand teach the value of asking early.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 六月，阿亮和小莫骑了两天的车去海边。
body.py: liù yuè, Ā Liàng hé Xiǎo Mò qí le liǎng tiān de chē qù hǎibiān.
body.en: In June, Ah Liang and Xiao Mo have been cycling for two days toward the sea.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 他们的计划很简单：下午到，晚上看日出以前的海。
body.py: tāmen de jìhuà hěn jiǎndān: xiàwǔ dào, wǎnshang kàn rìchū yǐqián de hǎi.
body.en: Their plan is simple: arrive in the afternoon, see the pre-dawn sea.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 可是离海边还有三十公里的时候，前面那条胎破了。
body.py: kěshì lí hǎibiān hái yǒu sānshí gōnglǐ de shíhou, qiánmiàn nà tiáo tāi pò le.
body.en: But thirty kilometres short of the coast the front tyre goes flat.

body.speaker: 小莫
body.zh: 我们带的工具不好用，钉子太粗。
body.py: wǒmen dài de gōngjù bù hǎoyòng, dīngzi tài cū.
body.en: The tools we carry do not work, the patch strip is too thick.

body.speaker: 阿亮
body.zh: 我早说过应该检查一遍。
body.py: wǒ zǎo shuō guò yīnggāi jiǎnchá yí biàn.
body.en: I said long ago we should have checked it once.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 风从海那边吹来，太阳慢慢下去。
body.py: fēng cóng hǎi nàbian chuī lái, tàiyáng màn man xiàqu.
body.en: The wind blows from the sea side and the sun slowly sinks.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 路边有一个补胎的摊子，一位大叔在收东西。
body.py: lù biān yǒu yí gè bǔ tāi de tānzi, yí wèi dàshū zài shōu dōngxi.
body.en: By the road is a tyre repair stall and an uncle is packing up.

body.speaker: 阿亮
body.zh: 大叔，能不能帮我们补一下？我们可以多付。
body.py: dàshū, néng bu néng bāng wǒmen bǔ yíxià? wǒmen kěyǐ duō fù.
body.en: Sir, could you repair it for us? We can pay extra.

body.speaker: 大叔
body.zh: 钱不钱的不重要。天黑了路上不好走。
body.py: qián bu qián de bú zhòngyào. tiān hēi le lù shàng bù hǎo zǒu.
body.en: Money is not the point. Once it is dark the road is hard going.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 他一边补一边问他们从哪里来，要去多久。
body.py: tā yìbiān bǔ yìbiān wèn tāmen cóng nǎlǐ lái, yào qù duō jiǔ.
body.en: While he patches he asks where they came from and how long they will stay.

body.speaker: 大叔
body.zh: 海边晚上比这儿凉十度，把厚衣服拿出来。
body.py: hǎibiān wǎnshang bǐ zhèr liáng shí dù, bǎ hòu yīfu ná chūlai.
body.en: The coast is ten degrees cooler at night, take out your warm clothes.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 二十分钟以后，两条胎都好了。
body.py: èrshí fēnzhōng yǐhòu, liǎng tiáo tāi dōu hǎo le.
body.en: Twenty minutes later both tyres are fine.

body.speaker: 小莫
body.zh: 我们本来要吵架，现在只想吃面。
body.py: wǒmen běnlái yào chǎojià, xiànzài zhǐ xiǎng chī miàn.
body.en: We were about to quarrel, now we only want noodles.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 那天他们没有看到日出以前的海。
body.py: nà tiān tāmen méiyǒu kàn dào rìchū yǐqián de hǎi.
body.en: That day they did not see the sea before sunrise.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 第二天早上五点，他们醒了，外面全是光。
body.py: dì èr tiān zǎoshang wǔ diǎn, tāmen xǐng le, wàimiàn quán shì guāng.
body.en: At five the next morning they wake up and everything outside is light.

blocks.title: Words in this story
body: 破 pò — to burst, to break
补胎 bǔ tāi — to patch a tyre

blocks.body: Think about it: Ah Liang blames his partner and the uncle solves the problem. Write three lines of your own ending using 一边…一边… yìbiān…yìbiān… (doing two things at once) and 比 bǐ (compared with).
